additional_info.subject: Issue reported from the RC
additional_info.body:
According to AWS charger YX5xq0 has a lot of Failure in Feedback line error message (Picture in attachments)
I rebooted that charger and it did not come back online. Before there was KF14 which was stuck and components that were mounted on the door were not getting power.
How should we proceed?

additional_info.subject: ID0402439-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P6 170000741]-Failure in Feedback line CRM:00641000987
additional_info.body:
Dear Harjunpaa, Sakari,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Abhinav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P6 170000741
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
YX5xq0
Problem Description
: Failure in Feedback line
Troubleshooting
:
As per the reported issue regarding the feedback on the failure line:
We need to inspect the
Mainbreaker_QA1
and trace its feedback line, which is being used for the PLC status. Kindly refer to the schematic below to help diagnose the issue.
Adding to that due to the lack of an SCB connection, remote troubleshooting options are limited.
The best course of action would be to have someone on-site to verify the following:
The router is connected to the internet.
The charger is powered.
Additionally, consider the potential reasons for the charger being offline on the SCB:
Internet issues with the Siemens router:
The WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet due to a failover function.
Perform a hard reset via "OCPP" (if connected to the OCPP server) or a local reboot to restore connectivity.
Data service of the mobile network operator might be unavailable:
Check if the SIM card is disabled/expired or incorrectly inserted. Clean and reinsert it into the XF3 and XF4 routers.
Monthly data volume might be exhausted.
Signal strength may have weakened due to changes in radio transmission conditions.
Ensure M2M contracts have IP enabled.
Backend-related issues:
Backend settings for the charger may have been modified.
The OCPP server on the backend might be unavailable.
Teltonika-related issues:
The router may have switched to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Possible hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
We also recommend carrying a spare QA1 and router and SIM in case a replacement is required.
As the charger is offline on SCB, we cannot determine the exact cause of the failure since the error flags and logs are not visible on SCB. Therefore, additional components may be required for troubleshooting and resolution. In this case, we recommend first bringing the charger back online
For future reference, your case number is
0402439
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
